title: Valenti Management
description: Valenti Management is known as the Tampa-based Wendy's franchise operator. They are extremely lax when it comes to cybersecurity and are unwilling to cooperate in preventing data leaks, which is why we offer you commercial and confidential documents such as: price lists and discount agreements with key suppliers/distributors; new product/menu launch plans and marketing strategies; franchise and partnership contracts; terms of supplier discounts and promotions; employee personal data (Social Security numbers, wage data, taxes, benefits, medical records); financial statements, tax returns, bank statements, and debt agreements; real estate leases, construction contracts, and area development plans; customer loyalty program and payment card data; supply chain logistics data, inventory, and confidential operational data; litigation, insurance, and internal audit files. As a result, they will lose their reputation with clients and employees and face legal action due to the leak.
